rules.statement: A court must be vigilant and cautious when granting interim relief that prevents the continuation of a bank's statutory enforcement process, particularly where the plaintiffs have not placed material sufficient to establish a sustainable claim.
rules.supporting_quote: It is well-settled law that the right of a licensed commercial bank to realise mortgaged property by parate execution under the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act is a substantive statutory right which cannot be lightly interfered with by Court.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act
